args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy
args.summary: checkout-api has been failing health checks since the latest deploy (v2.3.1) in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with error rate 0.18. Rolled back to the most recent healthy production release v2.3.0 in all regions.

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what I did:

## Actions taken

1. **Investigated** — `checkout-api` was running v2.3.1 in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), unhealthy with an 18% error rate. Deployment history confirmed v2.3.1 was the latest production release and unhealthy, while v2.3.0 (seq 1) was the most recent healthy production release.

2. **Rolled back** — Rolled `checkout-api` back to **v2.3.0** in all production regions. The rollback was verified as `rolled_out` across us-east, us-west, and eu-west.

3. **Opened incident** — Created **SEV2 incident INC-0001** ("checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy") describing the health check failures and the rollback to v2.3.0. The on-call engineer was paged.

## Verification

Post-rollback status confirms the service is now **healthy** on v2.3.0 in all regions with error rate back down to 0.2%.
